nodes.en: Event: schedule, GitHub/GitLab webhook or HTTP
nodes.zh: 事件：定时、GitHub/GitLab Webhook 或 HTTP

nodes.en: Whitelisted fields; only checked type, ID and link reach the prompt
nodes.zh: 字段白名单；只有校验过的类型、编号和链接进提示词

nodes.en: Pure decision appends facts and projections in one SQLite transaction
nodes.zh: 纯函数决策，事实与投影在同一 SQLite 事务提交

nodes.en: Chain deeper than 8 hops is recorded but not dispatched
nodes.zh: 处理链超过 8 层只记录不派发

nodes.en: Worker runs the agent CLI for one round; the process exits
nodes.zh: 接单程序让 Agent CLI 跑一轮，进程退出

nodes.en: Installed Claude Code, Codex, ACP or command agent
nodes.zh: 本机已装的 Claude Code、Codex、ACP 或命令行 Agent

nodes.en: Read the agent-autoloop block in the final message; ask for a rewrite up to twice
nodes.zh: 读最后一条消息里的 agent-autoloop 回执；读不懂最多让它重写两次

nodes.en: Card to Feishu, desktop or webhook; nothing runs while you decide
nodes.zh: 卡片推到飞书、桌面或 Webhook；你考虑时没有进程在跑

nodes.en: Your answer becomes a card.answered event
nodes.zh: 你的回答变成 card.answered 事件

edges.zh: 回执发出的事件，层数加一
